The '''442nd Siege Battalion''' was a [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] that served within the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. Specializing in [[Ground warfare/Legends|planetary assault]] missions, the battalion was deployed to [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|secure]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the [[19 BBY/Legends|final year]] of the war. The 442nd was also deployed during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], where it fought alongside [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]] against Separatist [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] within the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of a [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Separatist dreadnought]]. 

==Description==
The 442nd Siege Battalion was a [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Battalion/Legends|battalion]] that specialized in [[Ground warfare/Legends|planetary assault missions]].<ref name="442nd Saga Collection" /> It was one of four battalions that made up one of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic's]] [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Regiment/Legends|regiments]]. The 442nd Siege Battalion was composed of four [[Company/Legends|companies]] and had 576 clone [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] under its command,<ref name="Battalion structure" /> including [[AT-RT driver]]s,<ref name="PocketModels 442nd ATRT" /> along with support personnel.<ref name="Battalion structure" />

Led by a [[clone battalion commander]], a [[Clone major/Legends|clone trooper major]], and a [[Lieutenant Colonel/Legends|Lieutenant Colonel]],<ref name="Battalion leadership" /> the battalion's clone troopers wielded the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]] [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]] and the [[DC-15A blaster rifle/Legends|DC-15A blaster rifle]], and wore [[Phase II clone trooper armor/Legends|Phase II clone trooper armor]] with [[Color/Legends|lime green]] markings.<ref name="442nd Sideshow">{{SideshowCite|set=Militaries of Star Wars|packtype=Sixth Scale Figure|pack=442nd Siege Battalion Clone Trooper|altlink=https://www.rebelscum.com/SSC-442Clone.asp}}</ref> The unit also utilized [[All Terrain Recon Transport/Legends|All Terrain Recon Transports]]<ref name="PocketModels 442nd ATRT" /> and [[Infantry Support Platform/Legends|Infantry Support Platforms]] that sported lime green markings.<ref name="PocketModels 442nd Speeder" />

==History==
[[File:442nd-coruscant.png|thumb|left|260px|The 442nd Siege Battalion participated in the Battle of Coruscant.]]
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], toward the end of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]],<ref name="Labyrinth of Evil">''[[Labyrinth of Evil]]''</ref> the 442nd Siege Battalion was deployed to [[Siege of Cato Neimoidia|capture]] the<ref name="442nd Saga Collection" /> [[Colonies/Legends|Colonies]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]], a key [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] stronghold.<ref name="442nd Saga Collection" /> The same [[Standard year|year]],<ref name="SWE3">{{Film|III}}</ref> the 442nd Siege Battalion participated in<ref name="SW:BF2 cover" /> the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], assisting [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Agen Kolar/Legends|Agen Kolar]]<ref name="Agen Kolar DB">{{DB|character|agenkolar|Kolar, Agen}}</ref> in a skirmish against<ref name="SW:BF2 cover" /> Separatist [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droids]] and [[droideka]]s,<ref name="The New Essential Guide to Droids">''[[The New Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref> within the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] of a<ref name="SW:BF2 cover" /> [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|Providence-class carrier/destroyer]].<ref name="TEGTW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> At least one member of the battalion then took part in the [[Battle of Utapau/Legends|Battle of Utapau]].<ref name="Foe">''[[Obi-Wan's Foe]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
===Origins and development===
[[File:Clones_variations_concept_rots.png|thumb|right|340px|Concept art of a 442nd Siege Battalion clone trooper (third from right), designed by Alex Jaeger.]]
The 442nd Siege Battalion was first pictured, albeit without being named, in the reference book ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]'',<ref name="RotS Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> written by [[James Luceno]] and published on [[April 2]], [[2005]].<ref name="RotS VD date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iii/release/publishing/news20041124.html|text=Planning Your Episode III Bookshelf}}</ref> The battalion was later identified as part of an action figure in [[Hasbro]]'s [[2006]] ''[[Star Wars: The Saga Collection]]'' line of toys.<ref name="442nd Saga Collection" />

The design for the 442nd Siege Battalion's clone troopers was originally concept art for the 2005 film {{Film|III}}. The art was created by [[Alex Jaeger]] as part of a series of concept art pieces depicting different clone troopers designed for different theaters of war. The design was first showcased in the [[Prequel Update]] section of the [[Star Wars Insider 74|seventy-fourth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="Insider 74">{{InsiderCite|74|Prequel Update}}</ref> written by [[Jane Irene Kelly]] and released on [[February 24]], [[2004]].<ref name="Insider BTS">{{SWArchive|url=community/news/2004/01/news20040126.html|text=Clone Trooper Front and Center in ''Insider'' #74}}</ref>

===''LEGO Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith''===
[[File:Lego-442nd.png|thumb|left|140px|A LEGO 442nd Siege Battalion trooper.]]
The 2005 [[LEGO Star Wars|LEGO ''Star Wars'']] set "Wookiee Catamaran" showcased two 442nd Siege Battalion troopers [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] an Infantry Support Platform while being fired upon by an<ref name="LEGO Catamaran">{{LEGOCite|num=7260|name=Wookiee Catamaran}}</ref> [[Oevvaor jet catamaran/Legends|Oevvaor jet catamaran]]<ref name="Catamaran DB">{{DB|vehicle|catamaran|Wookiee flying catamaran}}</ref> carrying [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Masters]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], and a Wookiee [[Soldier/Legends|warrior]].<ref name="LEGO Catamaran" />

Replacing the "Clone (Episode III, [[Swamp/Legends|Swamp]])" characters from the 2005 ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]'', which originally had blue markings on their [[Armor/Legends|armor]],<ref name="LEGO SW:TVG">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Video Game]]''</ref> the 442nd Siege Battalion made its first appearance in ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|non-canonical]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[Traveller's Tales]] and published by [[LucasArts]]<ref name="LEGO SW:TCS">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga]]''</ref> on [[November 6]], [[2007]].<ref name="LEGO SW:TCS date>{{GameSpot|url=lego-star-wars-the-complete-saga/platform/xbox360|text=LEGO Star Wars: The Complete Saga (Xbox)}}</ref> 

In the game's [[Battle of Kashyyyk/Legends|Defense of Kashyyyk]] level, the battalion's clone troopers were shown [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|hunting down]] Jedi Master Yoda and Chewbacca on the planet [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], following the activation of [[Contingency Orders for the Grand Army of the Republic: Order Initiation, Orders 1 Through 150|contingency]] [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]]. The 442nd's clone troopers attempted to stop the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from reaching his [[Homemade evacuation pod|escape pod]], but ultimately failed as he escaped the planet. Following the completion of the level, the player may unlock a 442nd clone trooper as a playable character for 12,000 LEGO studs, who was also called "Clone (Episode III, Swamp)."<ref name="LEGO SW:TCS" />

The 442nd Siege Battalion was incorrectly identified as the 42nd Siege Battalion in the [[2011]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]'' reference book written by [[Hannah Dolan]].<ref name="LEGO SWCE">''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia]]''</ref> The [[2015]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]'' reference book also incorrectly identified the battalion as the 42nd Siege Battalion.<ref name="LEGO SWCE:UE">''[[LEGO Star Wars Character Encyclopedia: Updated and Expanded]]''</ref>
